_comment: VLM sample: Qwen3-VL through the GenieNode/GeniePipeline composable pipeline. A chat request carrying an image_url content part is routed to a VLM slot automatically. Copy next to genie-server.py as env_config.json and adjust paths.
_comment_text_slots: NO TEXT SLOTS HERE, to keep this sample to one thing. A text model and a VLM CAN be resident together on the SA8255P we tested, but only when the text bundle is exported at a SINGLE context length and the two slots are on DIFFERENT device_id; with a multi-context-length text bundle the second slot fails with 'err 1002' whichever loads first. For that configuration start from env_config.text-vlm.sample.json instead, and read MANUAL.md, 'Loading two models at once'.

VLM_SLOTS._comment: max_tokens caps generation for the whole slot: the request's own max_tokens cannot reach the VLM path (GenieNode takes it once, at node creation). 0 = uncapped.
VLM_SLOTS.name: vision
